messages:
Miguel: Heads up — escalation from Support about a p99 spike after the quantization profile rollout for model 'gpt-lite-13B-int8'. Customer: AcmeRetail on Dedicated. Symptoms: overall p95 +50ms, p99 +400ms for short chat requests (<= 128 tokens). Happened after we flipped profile v3 -> v4 late last night. Repro steps and logs below.

Elaine: :eyes: Do we know if calibration completed successfully? Any kernel fallbacks showing up in the runtime logs?

Miguel: Repro steps I used locally (dedicated replica in eu-west-1):
```bash
# simulate customer's request shape
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST https://dedicated.eu-west-1.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite-13B-int8","input":"Tell me a short product summary","max_tokens":64}'
```
Observed p50=35ms, p95=120ms, p99=480ms. Baseline before profile change was p99 ~ 90ms.

Miguel: Relevant excerpt from runtime log during an affected request:
```
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] kernel_selector: selected kernel=matmul_int8_opt for layer=1
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] quant::calibration: layer=7 calibration variance high -> marking unstable
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] fallback: switching layer=7 to fp16 due to quantization instability
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] kv_cache: flush start
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] kv_cache: stall 320ms waiting for fp16->int8 conversion
[2026-02-28T02:13:44Z] request: latency p99=480ms
```
Looks like intermittent fallback from int8 to fp16 is causing heavy stalls at conversion points (fp16->int8 / int8->fp16). Fallbacks are per-request and expensive.

Elaine: OK that matches my suspicion. v4 tightened per-layer quant thresholds which can cause frequent per-batch fallbacks when activation distributions differ from calibration set. Did we run calibration using customer-like prompts? How many samples?

Miguel: We used the default calibration sample_count=64 and the canned conversational corpus. Customer traffic has a lot of short numeric SKU strings and lots of punctuations which diverged.

Kevin: Quick mitigation options:
- Temporarily pin the customer's model to profile v3 (older quant profile) for their Dedicated pool.
- Disable int8 for that model and force fp16 until we re-calibrate.
- Increase calibration sample_count and re-run calibration with customer-supplied prompt set.
- Add a runtime guard to avoid conversion in the hot path (batch-level quantize once, reuse).

Alex_Support: I've already informed AcmeRetail that we're investigating and offered to revert to prior profile. They gave consent to roll back.

Miguel: How to flip off int8 for this model quickly (admin API):
```bash
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/admin/models/gpt-lite-13B-int8/config \
  -d '{"quant_profiles":{"active":"v3"}}'
```
Or to force fp16:
```bash
-d '{"runtime_overrides":{"prefer_fp16":true}}'
```
This takes effect on new allocations within the Dedicated pool; existing workers will drain. Expected rollback time ~3-6 minutes for small pools.

Elaine: Long-term fix: re-run calibration with a larger and more diverse sample set (512-2048) that includes customer prompts; update v4 to increase per-layer stability margin. Also add a telemetry counter for per-request fallback events so we can alert when >1% of requests cause fallback.

Kevin: Small runtime patch we can ship as hotfix: when a layer toggles fallback more than N times in M seconds, mark the whole request to use fp16 for the remainder of response (fast path) instead of toggling per-layer. That should reduce conversion stalls. I'll draft PR.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-234. Severity: P2. Owner: Miguel.

Miguel: Rolling customer back to v3 now. Patch command executed at 02:42Z. Monitoring metrics...

(5m later) Miguel: After rollback p95 returned to baseline, p99 dropped back to ~95ms. Customer confirmed better UX.

Elaine: Follow-ups:
- Reproduce locally with a larger calibration sample set and the customer's prompt corpus.
- Add an e2e test in CI that runs quick quantization stability check for new profiles against varied prompt shapes.
- Instrument fallback counters and add alert rule (pager if fallback rate > 0.5% over 5m).

Alex_Support: Customer happy with rollback. They want an ETA for a safe re-roll of v4. I told them we'll do testing with their corpus and a staged canary.

Kevin: Action items assigned:
- Miguel: coordinate customer-specific calibration and test in dedicated staging (due EOD).
- Kevin: open runtime patch PR to reduce per-request conversion stalls (in progress).
- Elaine: add fallback telemetry + alert (tomorrow).

Miguel: Marking thread resolved for the immediate escalation. Will follow up with PR links and calibration report in this thread once done. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-234 status -> resolved
